t: Dock tech: Ships set down on the pad here. Mirefen Village is just east along the boardwalk.
Bog hiker: Stay on the planks. The bog looks like moss, but it's mostly water and bad decisions.
Spore tender: Mirefen stands on stilts. When the bog breathes, the whole village sways a little.
Botanist: The mushrooms glow brighter near the tower to the east. Dr. Moor says they're listening.
Bog hiker: Toxin-types hide in the reed beds. Carry Cure Spray, or the walk home gets long.
Villager: The dome with the cyan cross is the Recovery Bay. Rest up before you head into the marsh.
Grandmother: My grandson swears he was lost in the Mushroom Maze for a whole day. It was an hour.
Pilgrim: I came to hear the Spore Choir at the pools. On still nights the spores hum in harmony.
Man in a white coat: Helix? Never heard of them. I'm just... sampling the mushrooms. For science.
Traveler: The Keeper here guards a Signal Shard. Climb her tower and she'll test you herself.
Nurse: Welcome to the Mirefen Recovery Bay. Spore-sick or battle-worn, we'll patch your team up.
Visitor: Healing here is free. Step up to the counter whenever your team is hurting.
Clerk: Stasis Pods, Cure Spray, the works. In spore season the Cure Spray sells out fast.
Shopper: Weaken a wild alien before you throw a Stasis Pod. Healthy ones just pop right back out.
Lost hiker: I've passed that stone shrine three times. I'm starting to think it follows me.
Lab aide: Dr. Moor's apprentices guard this floor. Beat them and the stairs to her lab are yours.
Lab aide: Beat Dr. Moor and she'll hand over Sporeholm's Signal Shard. Bring Cure Spray. Trust me.
Botanist: Every lantern in this marsh is a living fungus. Don't pick them. They bite back.
Bog hiker: Wild aliens jump out of the reeds. Stick to the dirt paths if your team is tired.
Spore tender: The Mushroom Maze is just ahead. Left at the glowing caps... or was it right?
Wanderer: Trainers watch the paths. Step into their line of sight and it's a battle.
Mycologist: These bridges grow on their own. The mushrooms knit the planks back together each night.
Pilgrim: Listen... the Spore Choir. The pools sing when the spores rise. Some say the tower answers.
Spore tender: The big lily pads hold your weight. Mostly. Hop across them to reach the tower path.

notes: Sporeholm (03), V2 maps: positions rewired for the V2 renders (tools/sections/v2).
